name: Damascus Steel Chef Knife
shortDesc: Hand-forged VG10 Damascus chef knife with ergonomic octagonal handle.
description: A premium 8-inch chef knife featuring 67 layers of Japanese VG10 Damascus steel. The razor-sharp edge retains its bite through heavy use, while the octagonal walnut handle offers supreme comfort and control. Perfect for both professional kitchens and home cooking enthusiasts.

name: Tactical Folding Knife
shortDesc: Lightweight D2 steel folding knife with G10 handle and ball-bearing pivot.
description: Designed for everyday carry, this tactical folder features a 3.5-inch D2 tool steel blade with a stonewashed finish. The ball-bearing pivot ensures silky-smooth deployment, and the textured G10 handle provides a secure grip in any condition.

name: Japanese Santoku Knife
shortDesc: 7-inch Santoku with granton edge for precise slicing and dicing.
description: The Santoku is the Japanese answer to the Western chef knife. This 7-inch variation uses high-carbon stainless steel with a granton (scalloped) edge to reduce friction and prevent food from sticking. Ideal for vegetables, fish, and boneless meats.

name: Steak Knife Set (4pc)
shortDesc: Serrated steak knives with full-tang construction and polished handles.
description: Elevate your dining experience with this set of four full-tang steak knives. Each blade features micro-serrated edges that glide effortlessly through any cut of meat. The polished resin handles add a touch of elegance to your dinner table.

name: Minimalist Leather Wallet
shortDesc: Ultra-slim vegetable-tanned leather wallet with 6 card slots.
description: Crafted from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, this minimalist wallet ages beautifully with a rich patina. It features 6 card slots, a bill compartment, and a hidden pocket — all while staying remarkably thin in your front pocket.

name: RFID Blocking Bifold
shortDesc: Classic bifold wallet with RFID-blocking lining and ID window.
description: A timeless bifold design updated with modern security. The built-in RFID-blocking lining protects your cards from digital theft, while the clear ID window and multiple compartments keep everything organized and accessible.

name: Carbon Fiber Money Clip
shortDesc: Lightweight carbon fiber money clip with expandable card holder.
description: For those who carry light, this carbon fiber money clip weighs next to nothing while securely holding your bills and up to 6 cards. The spring-steel clip maintains tension over thousands of uses.

name: Custom Engraving Service
shortDesc: Add a personalized laser engraving to any engravable product.
description: Make it truly yours. Our precision laser engraving service can add names, initials, dates, or short messages to any engravable product in our catalog. Choose from multiple fonts and preview your design before checkout.
